A1.justification: Both PDFs are complete, readable versions of the same GenARM paper. Their main text, figures, tables, equations, and Appendices A–C can be matched reliably despite pagination changes.

before.justification: v4 reports original alignment experiments, inference timings, weak-to-strong guidance results, and multi-objective evaluations in Section 6, with additional results and training-cost measurements in Appendix C.

after.justification: v5 retains these original empirical results, including Tables 1–2, the experimental figures, and Appendix C measurements.

M1.justification: The autoregressive reward parameterization, preference-training objective, guided decoding procedure, and multi-objective extension remain unchanged in Section 4 and Equations (4)–(8).

E1.justification: Both versions use the same HH-RLHF, UltraFeedback, AlpacaEval 2, and PKU-SafeRLHF-10K coverage for general alignment, weak-to-strong guidance, and multi-objective alignment. No dataset or test scenario is added or removed.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged: ARGS, CARDS, Transfer-Q, and DPO in Section 6.1; base models, ARGS, BoN, and DPO in Section 6.2; and Rewarded Soups and MORL in Section 6.3. Appendix comparisons are also retained.

E3.justification: Training and evaluation settings are unchanged, including model scales, generation parameters, GPT-4 judging prompts, and metrics. The evaluations retain 300 HH-RLHF prompts, 805 AlpacaEval 2 prompts, and 500 multi-objective prompts.

E4.justification: The token-reward visualization in Figure 3, response case study in Figure 5, and training-cost comparison in Appendix C.1 are unchanged. No ablation, robustness test, or supplementary analysis is added or removed.

E5.justification: Table 1 retains the same uncertainty entries. No repeated-run counts, seed information, uncertainty-estimation procedures, confidence intervals, or statistical tests are added or revised.

E6.justification: Numerical results and qualitative findings match throughout, including the appendix plots. For example, Table 1 retains GenARM's 51.44±0.35% win-plus-half-tie score against DPO, and Table 2 retains its 7.28-second inference time.

T1.justification: Section 5 retains the same reward-equivalence definition, lemma, theorem, and proof sketch. Appendix B.1 retains Theorem 4, Corollary 5, and their existence and uniqueness proofs without mathematical changes.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same claims about expressive reward parameterization, efficient test-time alignment, performance relative to training-time methods, weak-to-strong guidance, and multi-objective flexibility.

C2.justification: Interpretations of token-level guidance, the advantage-function connection, and reference-length effects in comparisons remain unchanged. Section 7 retains the same limitation that applications beyond human-preference alignment require further exploration.

D1.justification: Implementation details, hyperparameters, checkpoint links, quantization disclosures, hardware information, training times, and evaluation prompts are unchanged in Section 6 and Appendix C. The project-page disclosure is also unchanged.

R1.justification: The cited works, reference entries, and positioning relative to prior alignment methods remain unchanged in Section 2 and Appendix A.

P1.justification: v5 adds author markers and footnotes identifying Xu's JPMorgan Chase internship and Huang's support through the JPMC Faculty Research Award program at UMD. Scientific prose, terminology, and section ordering remain unchanged.

P2.justification: The author footnotes and adjusted author block produce text and table reflow. The final Appendix C.4 evaluation template now extends onto a short page 22. All eight figures and both tables retain their content and design.

improvement.justification: v5 clarifies author research circumstances through two footnotes but preserves the scientific argument, empirical evidence, proofs, and reproducibility information. The resulting pagination changes, including the short final appendix page, do not materially improve or weaken overall paper quality.
